subject: general
question:
The given histogram shows average percentage score of boys and girls in an examination during the year 2014-2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a74d9cb07c46572ee3e400ed3fc40154789617fcb057e91b1ef834e7c2f1b6.png] 

What is the absolute difference between the overall average score of boys and that of girls during the five years?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average score of boys and girls during the year 2014 - 2018

**CONCEPT USED:**

Average = Sum of values/No. of values.

**CALCULATION:**

In the year 2014

score of boys = 65

score of girls = 60 

In the year 2015 

score of boys = 80

score of girls = 65

In the year 2016 

score of boys = 80

score of girls = 75

In the year 2017

score of boys = 65

score of girls = 80

In the year 2018

score of boys = 60

score of girls = 80 

⇒ Sum of boys in all the years = (65 + 80 + 80 + 65 + 60) = 350

⇒ Average = 350/5 = 70.

⇒ Sum of girls in all 5 years = (60 + 65 + 75 + 80 + 80) = 360 

⇒ Average = 360/5 = 72.

⇒ Absolute difference = (72 - 70) = 2.

**The absolute difference is 2.**
